alt: A sculpted cake depicting an Amazon rainforest scene with a toucan perched in a tree canopy, a sloth clinging to the trunk, and a spotted jaguar prowling at the base among flowers and moss, with a stream flowing through the foreground.
A sculpted cake featuring a jaguar crouching on a rocky outcrop above a translucent stream with colorful fish swimming below, surrounded by vibrant mushrooms, moss, and a braided vine border.
A sculpted cake showcasing a cascading waterfall tumbling over rocks into a pool, framed by textured tree trunks, sprawling roots, and patches of green moss in a serene woodland setting.
